scutum.popis: one Roman legionary curved rectangular shield (scutum): red painted wooden body curved like a half cylinder, yellow painted wings and lightning bolts, brass edging all around, iron square boss plate with a round iron dome in the centre, complete

popis_pohled.back: one Roman legionary curved rectangular shield (scutum) seen from behind, the concave inside: bare plain wooden planks, a horizontal wooden hand grip behind the central boss, brass edging around the rim, no paint and no decoration on the inside
popis_pohled.right: one Roman legionary curved rectangular shield (scutum) seen exactly from its side edge: a tall narrow curved profile like a bent board with the iron dome boss sticking out in the middle, brass edging

pilum.popis: one Roman heavy javelin (pilum) lying alone: long wooden shaft, square wooden block and a round lead weight ball at the joint, long thin iron shank ending in a small pyramidal iron point, iron butt spike at the other end, complete, whole length visible
